import datetime,difflib,hashlib,json,pathlib
B=pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/actual-source-regular-local-collar-construct')
S=pathlib.Path('/workspace/Math-curvature-20261026/frontiers/source_derivative_gaussian_20261025/SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean')
old=S.read_text();new=old
assert new.count('field_simp [ha] <;> ring')==2;assert new.count('field_simp [hb] <;> ring')==2
new=new.replace('field_simp [ha] <;> ring','field_simp [ha]\n      ring').replace('field_simp [hb] <;> ring','field_simp [hb]\n      ring')
assert new.count('(contDiff_apply j).sub')==1;new=new.replace('(contDiff_apply j).sub','(contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ j).sub')
H=B/'history/helper-fix001';H.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False);orig=H/'SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean.ORIGINAL';orig.write_text(old);S.write_text(new)
p=B/'HELPER_FIX001_FULL.patch';p.write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(keepends=True),new.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='history/helper-fix001/SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean.ORIGINAL',tofile='SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean')))
cp=B/'FIRST_ID_CACHE.json';cache=json.loads(cp.read_text());prior=cache[str(S)];st=orig.stat();cache[str(orig)]={**prior,'path':str(orig),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'origin':'Known exact prior source ID REUSED; no hash','copied_from':str(S)}
st=p.stat();cache[str(p)]={'path':str(p),'bytes':st.st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'first_observed_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'origin':'FIRST actual full helper amendment patch identity, once'}
cp.write_text(json.dumps(cache,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'scope':'Only public001 four tactic-style findings and contDiff_apply explicit scalar/carrier argument','full_patch':str(p),'helper_integrations':1}))
